title: Guided intake wizard with RL feedback loop for enterprise hosted multi-turn streaming requests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Enterprise customers frequently submit complex multi-turn streaming + tool-calling feature requests that are underspecified, leading to long intake cycles and missed SLO expectations. Goal: Build a guided intake wizard (hosted in Console + an API webhook) that collects structured signals, suggests routing & priority, and continuously learns from downstream outcomes via a lightweight reinforcement learning feedback loop. The wizard should: 1) surface required tech & compliance signals (data residency, tooling, latency targets, model types), 2) generate a priority score and recommended SLA lane, 3) propose rollout strategies (canary, staged burst), and 4) capture follow-up clarifying questions for PM/SE review. Acceptance criteria: prototype flow in Console, API schema for intake submissions, RL reward signal defined (e.g., time-to-resolution, rollout success), and initial pilot with 3 enterprise customers.
